claim_boundary: This is a zero-new-parameter, two-frozen-backbone development sufficiency test on previously characterized seeds 2102 and 2103. It can test whether one prospectively defined differential-admission rule explains stable-omitted direct errors. It cannot establish network-population prevalence, biological memory stores, unique tensor-product coding, a full subject evidence model, or formal confirmation on unseen backbones.

registered_rules.all_links_pass: Differential evidence admission is sufficient on both frozen development backbones. Preserve v2.3 and v2.4, then freeze an independent-backbone confirmation contract before making a population claim.
registered_rules.competence_or_integrity_failure: The affected seed is non-interpretable. Repair execution under the same frozen contract without changing equations, maps, seeds, margins, or outcome rules.
registered_rules.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: If a link passes in only one seed, label it heterogeneous_or_unresolved; do not pool participant rows, average it into a pass, replace a seed, or modify the candidate.
registered_rules.link_replication: A link passes the development pilot only if its full within-seed rule passes independently in both 2102 and 2103.
registered_rules.valid_failure: If omitted rescue fails in both seeds under intact competence, reject the simple lower-local-threshold account and revisit the subject-specific evidence model rather than changing L_T address, gain, or query mechanism.
registered_rules.valid_local_only_globalization: Reject the rule if P-off recovers nonlearned/remote inference; L_T is acting as a second global learner rather than direct-experience persistence.
registered_rules.valid_omitted_rescue_without_specificity: Reject the differential-routing interpretation: extra local evidence energy helps but correct evidence-to-relation or trace-to-query binding is not identified.
registered_rules.valid_rescue_with_retained_harm: Reject this admission rule as a working model even if omitted cells improve; broader access is trading away the already replicated retained channel.

registered_rules.evidence_and_query_specificity: Within each seed, dual-access matched beats evidence shuffle on both omitted exact probability and omitted direct causal correctness, and beats query shuffle on omitted direct causal correctness; all three paired participant-bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero.
registered_rules.local_only_nontransitive_access: Within each seed under P-off, omitted exact probability has a participant-bootstrap lower bound above 0.50, candidate-minus-shared omitted exact probability has a paired lower bound above zero, sampled nonlearned accuracy has an upper bound at most 0.55, the all-source P-off remote-minus-0.25-times-shared-access all-source remote contrast has an upper bound below zero, and local-off preserves every global competence gate.
registered_rules.omitted_direct_fidelity_rescue: Within each seed, both the participant-bootstrap lower bound for omitted dual-access-minus-shared exact probability and the lower bound for omitted dual-access-minus-shared direct causal correctness exceed zero.
registered_rules.retained_fidelity_preservation: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for retained dual-access-minus-shared exact probability is at least -0.005, and retained own-write identity passes within 1e-7. The -0.005 noninferiority margin is frozen below the seed-2101 retained rescue magnitude and before any v2.4 result.

execution_contract.cpu_threads: PyTorch intra-op and inter-op threads fixed to one by configure_runtime; NumPy and BLAS settings unchanged.
execution_contract.joint_result_write: Both seeds are evaluated in one process and the result is written only after both complete.
execution_contract.neural_execution: Frozen seed-2102 and seed-2103 checkpoint replay on a visible CUDA GPU; no training, adaptation, compilation, or parameter update occurs in v2.4.

lock.immutability: Any execution repair after evaluation begins requires a superseding implementation lock naming the defect; the admission equation, reused backbones and gains, conditions, maps, LOO semantics, estimands, thresholds, and both-seed rule remain unchanged.
lock.result_contract: The first v2.4 evaluation may run only after this implementation lock, the runner, and tests are committed and pushed to origin/dev.
